2829-3139-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-3139-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
2829-3139-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3175-8095-8207.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

277-997-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-997-2577-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4753-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4753-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Omni-Changeling each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4753-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1394-2060-5231-6627-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
2921-6972-7230.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

333-2281-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-673-1031.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-1031.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-4766-5222-6798.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender and Sword of the Realms attached to the same nontoken creature you control.
1069-4766-5222-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with Sword of the Realms and Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Sword of the Realms and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {0}, attaching it to the creature that has Deathrender attached.
Repeat.

4222-4694-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-4694-6788.description:
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-4694-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1818-2034-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1818-2034-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Healer of the Pride indestructible.
1818-2034-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-4050-4885.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

2335-3143-3197-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
You control at least one additional creature.
2335-3143-3197-4613.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

945-1385-2438-2452-2530.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
945-1385-2438-2452-2530.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {0}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Relentless Dead.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Zulaport Cutthroat.
Resolve the first Relentless Dead trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Relentless Dead trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

687-2012-2034-3818.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-2012-2034-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Strangleroot Geist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4050-4840-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Myr Battlesphere to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

2232-2532-4891.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2232-2532-4891.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Atsushi with haste.
Put the token Atsushi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cloudstone Curio triggers once, and the token Atsushi triggers twice.
Resolve the first Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Atsushi trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Jaxis from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Jaxis for its blitz cost by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1486-1651-3734.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph for {3}{U/P}, choosing to have it enter as an artifact copy of Magda.
Put the original Magda in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clock of Omens and Magda, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping a Treasure token and Magda, targeting Magda.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Activate Magda's last ability any number of times by sacrificing any number of Treasures.

770-1636.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
770-1636.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Man-o'-War.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Man-o'-War's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
